hero_eyebrow: Established 1991 · Under the aegis of the DPS Society, New Delhi
hero_lead: For over three decades we have nurtured the body, mind, heart and soul of every child — so they can excel in academics and leave a legacy.
about_md:
Delhi Public School Visakhapatnam was established in 1991 and imparts quality education with the most modern teaching techniques, so its students can compete with the world. It provides a congenial atmosphere for the total development of the whole personality and its integration with society.

The school inculcates personal hygiene, neatness, cleanliness, graceful manners and discipline, in an environment that fosters a spirit of enquiry and keen competition — with personal attention to every child and a competent, supportive staff.

Board pass rate, five years running

why.title: Consistent academic excellence
why.text: 100% pass in Classes X and XII every year from 2020-21 to 2025-26, with toppers scoring 98.8% and 96.8%.

why.title: Well-equipped laboratories
why.text: Separate Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Maths and Computer Science labs for hands-on learning.

why.title: Digital classrooms
why.text: Technology and automation built into the school system, equipping students with 21st-century skills.

why.title: A library that is always growing
why.text: Over 6,000 reference books, 12 magazines, 4 periodicals and 5 dailies — replenished regularly.

why.title: Sprawling playground
why.text: More than 32,000 sq. m of playground, indoor games, and a full calendar of sports and Inter-House events.

why.title: Arts, music & dance
why.text: Dedicated music and dance rooms, art and painting, dramatics, creative writing and public speaking.

why.title: International dimension
why.text: Recognised by the British Council for an International Dimension in Schools (2026–2029).

why.title: Character first
why.text: Service before Self: assemblies, house system, scholar awards and a clear, fair discipline policy.
